name: contact-05
description: A list of studio offices with time zones, phone numbers and copyable emails.

files.content:
"use client" import { useState } from "react" import { Check, Copy, ExternalLink, Mail, } from "@designali/icons" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" const offices = [ { city: "Studio", timezone: "New projects", email: "hello@designali.com", link: "Book a call", href: "https://cal.com/aliimam/30min", address: ["Brand identity, UI/UX design", "Web design and Next.js development"], }, { city: "Support", timezone: "Templates & blocks", email: "support@designali.com", link: "Read the docs", href: "https://www.designali.com/docs", address: ["Help with templates, blocks", "@designali/icons and logos"], }, { city: "Billing", timezone: "Orders & licenses", email: "billing@designali.com", link: "View pricing", href: "https://www.designali.com/pricing", address: ["Invoices, refunds and", "Designali Pro licenses"], }, ] export default function Contact05() { const [copied, setCopied] = useState(null) function copy(value: string) { navigator.clipboard?.writeText(value) setCopied(value) setTimeout(() => setCopied(null), 1600) } return (

Three desks,
one studio.

Reach the right desk at Designali. Every email lands with Ali Imam and the studio team.

{offices.map((office) => (

{office.city}

{office.timezone}
{office.address.map((line) => ( {line} ))}
))}
